plain: A gift of money, beyond what is owed

webster.text: A free gift; a present; a donation; that which is given without a compensation or equivalent.

more.text: Something given in return for a favor; an acknowledgment.

example.quote: Hence the undertakers of a new manufacture have to contend not only with the natural disadvantages a new undertaking, but with the gratuities and remunerations which other governments bestow.
example.cite: Alexander Hamilton, Report on Manufactures (communicated to the House of Representatives, Dec. 5, 1791)
